title: Three Nights and One Short Shade
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：lamp　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lamp 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the keeper ① lit the lamp that no lodger in the inn would have recorded, and he said the lighting was the whole of the night. The ② lamp, meaning the light itself and not the shade, ran three nights and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lamp, he said, is the only thing in an inn that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lamp in that inn had the same short shade beside it, and the ④ lamp at the far stairs, meaning the wick they kept for the children to trim and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lamp, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the keeper said the recording is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lamp was the whole of the matter, meaning the warmth and not the light. The ⑥ lamp, meaning the warmth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lamp, he said, is either something you light or the only word that means both a light and a warmth. He said the warmth is the part they remember.

By 1960 the ⑦ lamp had become a line in a diary, and the diary had become an argument about the short shade. The ⑧ lamp of the whole thing, the keeper wrote in December, was one inn and three nights of recording; lamp, he said, is either the wick at the far stairs or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lamp I remember is the light recorded in the diary, which closed in 1962 and is still recorded as the quietest in the inn. A ⑩ lamp, my mother said in 1964, is the only light that improves by being recorded; every lamp, she said, is a warmth that has agreed to look like a light. She said the warmth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 灯；灯火（指客栈里每一盏旁边的那一盏）
B. n. 灯；灯火（指那盏灯本身，与灯罩相对）
C. 固定搭配：light the lamp 点亮这盏灯
D. n. 灯；灯火（指留给孩子们剪的那根灯芯那一盏）
E. n. 点灯之事（抽象总称，指一处客栈的灯之事）
F. n. 灯；灯火（指日记里写到、被记载的的那一盏）
G. n. 暖光、守候（指一件事里人人都点却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 守候（抽象总称，指人人都点却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: lit the lamp that no lodger in the inn would have recorded
The lamp, meaning the light itself and not the shade
the lamp at the far stairs
the lamp was the whole of the matter
the lamp had become a line in a diary
The lamp of the whole thing
A lamp, my mother said in 1964

answers.why: light the lamp 意为“点亮这盏灯”，1955 年那位守夜人把客栈里没有一位房客肯记载的一盏灯做了一遍。
lamp 意为“灯；灯火”，指那盏灯本身而不是灯罩，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。
lamp 意为“灯；灯火”，指客栈里每一盏旁边的那一盏，每一盏旁边都有同一个小小的灯罩。
lamp 意为“灯；灯火”，指最远那处楼梯口留给孩子们剪的那根灯芯那一盏，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lamp 意为“暖光、守候”，指一件事里人人都点却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份守候就是那件事的全部。
lamp 意为“守候”，指人人都点却无人提起的那样东西而不是那盏灯，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lamp 意为“灯；灯火”，指日记里写到、被记载的的那一盏，到 1960 年这一盏成了日记里的一行。
lamp 意为“点灯之事”，守夜人十二月写道，整件事的灯之事是一处客栈和三个夜晚的记载。
lamp 意为“灯；灯火”，我记得的是日记里记载过的那一盏，1962 年点亮了，至今仍被说成客栈里最安静的一盏。
lamp 为抽象总称，母亲 1964 年说，灯是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的灯。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年那位守夜人点亮了客栈里没有一位房客肯记载的一盏灯，他说这一遍才是那个夜晚的全部。（light the lamp）
那盏灯，指的是那盏灯本身而不是灯罩，经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记载。（lamp）
那处客栈里每一盏灯旁边都有同一个小小的灯罩。（lamp）
最远那处楼梯口那盏灯，指的是他们留给孩子们剪的那根灯芯那一盏，是唯一有人谢过两次的。（lamp）
叔叔说这份守候就是那件事的全部，指的是那样东西而不是那盏灯。（lamp）
1964 年母亲说，灯是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的灯。（lamp）

Every lamp in that inn had the same short shade beside it.
The lamp at the far stairs, meaning the wick they kept for the children to trim and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice.
